title: Minor versions below 75 are silently answered as minor version 75
summary: Since 2025-08-01 the QuickBooks Online Accounting API ignores any minorversion below 75 and responds with minor version 75 data, without an error. Code pinned to an older minor version receives a different response shape with no signal.
migrationNote: Set minorversion=75 (or remove it) and re-test parsing against minor version 75 responses.

provenance.quote: Others fail silently: since 1 August 2025, QuickBooks Online ignores any minor version below 75 and answers in version 75 without an error.
